title: Parrot
subtagline: Parrot pulls every conversation — Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, Telegram, Discord — into one inbox and gives you the context, drafts, and tools to reply in seconds instead of minutes.
bigStatement: Every unreplied DM is a missed fan, a lost deal, or a relationship that went cold.

valueProps.title: Your inbox is a graveyard.
valueProps.description: You have messages scattered across 6 apps. Some are weeks old. The people who sent them have already moved on. Parrot pulls everything into one screen so nothing dies in a tab you forgot to check.

valueProps.title: Reply in seconds, not minutes.
valueProps.description: Parrot reads the conversation, pulls in context from past interactions, and drafts a reply in your voice. You tweak it, hit send, move on. What used to take 2 minutes per message now takes 5 seconds.

valueProps.title: Know who matters. Act on it.
valueProps.description: Not all DMs are equal. Parrot tracks every interaction across platforms — who's been engaging for months, who just found you, who's going cold. So when you sit down to reply, you know exactly where to spend your energy.

audienceSections.title: If you're a creator or influencer
points: Your DMs are where superfans live and brand deals start. But past 50K followers, you can't keep up.
Parrot gives you drafts for every message, full context on who's writing, and smart suggestions so you can reply to 100 DMs in the time it used to take for 10.
Auto-handle the "what camera do you use?" questions. Give your real attention to the conversations that matter.

audienceSections.title: If you're a founder
points: Every DM could be a customer, investor, or hire. But you're building a company, so your inbox gets triaged by urgency and everything else gets forgotten.
Parrot drafts replies in your voice, flags high-value conversations, and gives you a CRM view of every relationship — so you stop losing warm leads to slow replies.

audienceSections.title: If you run community or sales
points: You're managing volume across platforms, often as a team.
Parrot gives you a kanban workflow (Unread → In Progress → Done), batch reply tools, and full conversation history across platforms.
Your team can move through hundreds of messages without dropping context, duplicating work, or letting anyone slip through.

featureSections.headline: Your voice. Zero effort.
featureSections.description: Parrot learns how you actually write — your slang, your emoji habits, whether you start messages with "yo" or "hey!" It drafts replies that sound like you wrote them at 1am, not like a chatbot generated them. You review, tweak if you want, and send. Every reply is yours. Parrot just got you there faster.

featureSections.headline: Everything you need. Before you ask.
featureSections.description: When you open a conversation, Parrot already knows what's going on: full history across platforms, who this person is, what you last talked about, and a suggested reply ready to go. It can pull relevant links from your clipboard, suggest attachments, and surface notes from your CRM — all before you type a single character.

featureSections.headline: Six apps. One screen.
featureSections.description: You're not checking WhatsApp, then Instagram, then LinkedIn, then X, then Telegram, then Discord every morning. Nobody is. That's why messages pile up and people think you're ignoring them. Parrot pulls everything into one view — threaded, searchable, and organized — so you can clear your inbox in minutes, not hours.

features.title: Voice Drafts
features.description: Replies that sound like you. Review, tweak, send. You stay in control.

features.title: Smart Context
features.description: Full conversation history, contact info, and CRM notes — surfaced automatically when you open a thread.

features.title: Unified Inbox
features.description: Every platform in one view. Stop switching between six apps.

features.title: Engagement Tracking
features.description: See who's a superfan, who's slipping away, who you haven't replied to in 2 weeks.

features.title: 10+ Platforms
features.description: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, X, and more.

features.title: Kanban Workflow
features.description: Drag conversations from Unread → In Progress → Done. Nothing gets lost.

closingCta.headline: Stop ghosting your audience.
closingCta.subheadline: Parrot is in alpha for macOS. Get early access.
